build_random_short_side_scale_jitter: build a random short side scale jitter transform for video frames with configurable min and max size
create_random_resized_crop: create an Inception-style random resized crop transform with configurable scale and aspect ratio ranges
test_random_resized_crop_with_shift: test the random resized crop with shift transform that interpolates crop boxes across video frames
refactor_random_resized_crop_and_interpo: refactor the RandomResizedCropAndInterpolation class to support random interpolation between bilinear and bicubic
summarize_normalize: summarize the Normalize class that normalizes video clips per channel with given mean and standard deviation
